tool_args.rationale: The five observations show monotone concave response, but s_grad is effectively constant and all rows use a single horizon. The available mechanism notes identify open branch sign/type as unresolved under this narrow pilot; the lower-cost open_branch_discriminating_probe targets that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with an open square-root branch or linear leak
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The current rows hold s_grad nearly fixed, so the sign/type of the branch term is not identifiable.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Their source notes also require a discriminating probe when s_grad span is below 0.08.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static Michaelis or other smooth saturation curve
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It may match the observed monotone concave trend but cannot resolve the indicated open-branch ambiguity.
No evidence points to a coupled-memory ODE, and this batch costs more than the branch-discriminating probe.
